prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-67146 from Pembury Logistics
prose.body:
Hi there,

Hope you're having a great week! Just wanted to send a quick and friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-67146, which is currently outstanding in the amount of 5331.52 USDC.

If you've already taken care of this, please accept our thanks, and you can disregard this note. Otherwise, please send the payment to our standard receiving wallet: 0xa0cea2f5b1f69cb464d8b750ca20d831e02670ad. This is the usual address we use for all incoming settlements, so it should be in your records as well.

We truly appreciate your business and look forward to continuing our partnership. If you need a copy of the invoice or have any questions about the payment details, just reply to this email or reach out to our accounts team. We're always happy to help.

Thanks again, and have a wonderful day!

Best regards,

The Accounts Team
Pembury Logistics
